full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white architectural photograph shows a bright white house with rounded horizontal forms beneath a deep dark sky. The building stands centered beyond a curved front path, with clipped dark lawn on either side and bare trees framing the upper corners. The lower front is broad and low, its smooth white walls interrupted by gridded windows at the left and right. A short run of steps leads to a recessed central entrance, where dark glass and narrow side openings sit in heavy shade. Above the doorway, a semicircular upper bay projects slightly forward beneath a wide, smooth, flat-edged roof cap. A continuous band of gridded windows follows its curve, emphasizing the horizontal sweep rather than a pointed or pitched silhouette. To the right, a taller rectangular chimney-like mass rises behind the upper floor, adding a single clear vertical counterpoint. The left side extends as another low curved volume, while the right edge turns back toward a plain wall and a tree's branching shadow. The facade has a smooth, almost plaster-like finish with minimal ornament; its interest lies in rounded corners, layered ledges, and the contrast between white walls and dark glazing. The camera faces the house nearly head-on from across the path, making the central approach and balanced asymmetry easy to read. Strong daylight from the upper left lights the open white planes and casts crisp branch shadows across the right side and the foreground. Thin bare branches form fine gray texture against the sky, while the built forms stay broad and calm. No people or readable text appear. The overall composition pairs streamlined curves with simple rectilinear masses, using high monochrome contrast and clear winter light to make the facade feel poised and aerodynamic.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白建筑照片呈现一座由明亮白色圆弧水平形体组成的住宅，背后是深暗天空。建筑位于弯曲前庭步道尽头的中央，两侧是修整过的深色草坪，光秃树木框住上方角落。前部低而宽阔，光滑白墙被左右两边的方格窗打断。几级台阶通向后退的中央入口，深色玻璃和狭窄侧窗沉在厚重阴影里。门上方，一个半圆形的上层窗湾略向前突出，由宽阔平滑、边缘平直的屋檐覆盖。连续的方格窗带沿弧线展开，强调水平扫动感，而不是尖顶或斜屋顶轮廓。右侧一个较高的矩形烟囱状体块在上层后方升起，成为唯一明确的竖向对照。左边延伸出另一个低矮弯曲体块，右边缘则退向素净墙面与树枝投下的阴影。立面近似灰泥的光滑完成面几乎没有装饰，趣味来自圆角、层叠边缘和白墙与深色玻璃的对比。相机从步道外几乎正面观看住宅，让中央入口路径和不完全对称的平衡都容易辨认。强烈日光从左上方照亮敞开的白色平面，在右侧和前景投下清晰的树枝影。细而光秃的树枝在天空前形成灰色纹理，建筑形体仍宽阔而宁静。画面无人，也没有可读文字。整体构图以流线弧形配合简洁矩形体量，借强烈的黑白对比和清楚的冬日光线，让立面显得稳定而富空气动力感。
style_prompt_en: The image has a clean photographic treatment that emphasizes smooth rounded profiles and long horizontal bands. Broad pale planes meet dark gridded openings with crisp edges, while shallow setbacks and layered ledges create restrained depth. Curves carry the eye laterally across the frame, and a few upright elements supply counter-rhythm without interrupting the overall flow. In this monochrome treatment, bright white surfaces stand against charcoal fields and middle-gray shadows; ornament is sparse, so proportion and silhouette do most of the work. The surfaces appear smooth and matte, with little grain beyond faint photographic tone and delicate linear shadows. Strong directional daylight makes the exposed shapes luminous and leaves sharp, readable shadows across adjacent planes. A steady frontal viewpoint gives the arrangement composure even when its parts differ in height. The overall effect is sleek, orderly, and lightly theatrical, with aerodynamic curves held in a clear graphic balance.
style_prompt_zh: 图像采用干净的摄影处理，强调平滑圆角轮廓和绵长的水平条带。宽阔浅色平面与深色格状开口以清晰边缘相接，浅浅的退台和层叠檐边形成克制的纵深。弧线引导视线横穿画面，少量直立元素提供反节奏，却不打断整体流动。在这种黑白处理中，明亮白色表面立于炭灰色域和中灰阴影前；装饰稀少，因此比例与剪影承担主要表达。表面平滑而哑光，除了轻微摄影色调与纤细线状阴影，几乎没有颗粒。强烈的定向日光使外露形体发亮，并在相邻平面留下锐利可读的阴影。稳定的正面视点让高度不一的各部分仍显得从容。整体效果流畅、有序又略带戏剧性，空气动力般的弧线保持在清晰的图形平衡中。
theme_en: A white Streamline Moderne house with a rounded upper bay and a curved front walk
theme_zh: 带圆弧上层窗湾与弯曲前庭步道的白色流线型现代住宅
name: Streamline Moderne architecture
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
